descriere:
PPC este liderul pieței de energie în Europa de Sud-Est. Produce, distribuie și furnizează energie electrică, precum și produse și servicii energetice avansate în Grecia, România și Macedonia de Nord. Grupul PPC are unități de producție cu o capacitate instalată de 10,7 GW și deservește 8,7 milioane de clienți pe mai multe piețe din regiune, cu peste 35 TWh de energie furnizată. Grupul este prezent în România în urma achiziției companiilor Enel în țara noastră în luna octombrie 2023. PPC a fost fondată în 1950 și este listată la Bursa de Valori din Atena.
PPC Romania Digital Solutions BucharestDetermined Period - 1 Year #WePowerYourTalent The energy transition happens through people who see their role beyond tasks and understand that what they do has a real impact. At PPC, we contribute every day to a safer and cleaner energy system, from the networks that connect communities, to renewable energy that transforms the energy mix, or solutions that make electric mobility accessible. Regardless of the role, our contribution is reflected every day in the communities we serve, in the customers who choose us, and in an energy system that is constantly evolving. We are present across the entire energy value chain and we are looking for motivated people to join us. advanced level Nice to have experience with: Understanding of cloud networking concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Knowledge of automation and scripting for network management (e.g., Python, Bash) But also:Ability to achieve goals by working independently.Crisis management skills, planning, prioritizing and organizing skillsCollaborates with other colleagues to support team spirit and the appropriate work atmosphereAbility to work on several activities in parallelWhat we offer you: A place where you grow, not just work Clear professional and personal development paths Access to courses, mentoring, and coaching programs Role-relevant certifications Real internal mobility opportunities within the PPC Romania Group A fair package that reflects your contribution Fixed annual bonus (equivalent of one salary) + performance bonus Meal vouchers worth 45 RON/day and bonuses (Energy Day, Easter, Christmas, etc.) Partial reimbursement of vacation costs (2,400 RON - PPC Contract) Additional vacation days + extra days off (birthday, Energy Day) Pillar III pension contribution worth 100 RON Bonus for employee referrals - ranging between 1,800 RON - 7,200 RON gross depending on the role Reimbursement for vision devices up to 700 RON, once every 2 years Voucher for partial compensation of energy consumption Real support for your well-being Medical subscription / private insurance Access to Bookster Partner offers Flexibility that respects your rhythm Hybrid schedule (office & smart working) Short Friday What else you should know Recruitment process confidentiality At PPC, we respect the confidentiality of every application. About PPC We are leaders in energy in South-East Europe, active in electricity production, distribution, and supply, as well as in developing innovative solutions for a sustainable future. With an installed capacity of 12.4 GW, we supply energy to 8.7 million customers and deliver over 35 TWh annually. In Romania, PPC became a top player following the acquisition of Enel companies in October 2023. With a history starting in 1950, we are listed on the Athens Stock Exchange and continuously expand our vision. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion We believe energy comes from people. At PPC, every voice matters, and diversity is the engine of our innovation. Regardless of age, ethnicity, gender, or disability, we offer an inclusive environment where you can grow and perform. #EnergyForEveryone - for your career, for the future, for all.
